step1Body: Tap Start camera and allow access in your browser.
step2Body: Pick the sign language you want to explore.
step3Body: Use good lighting and keep your hands in frame.
step4Body: A real model is needed for meaningful recognition; demo mode uses sample predictions.
step5Body: Hold both thumbs up steadily, lower your hands, then repeat.
step6Body: Choose a male or female system voice and adjust the volume.
faqVideoQ: Does my video leave my device?
faqVideoA: No video is uploaded by this app. The hand-tracking pipeline runs in your browser. Speaking a caption sends the caption text, not video, to your configured speech service.
faqRecognitionQ: Why is my sign not recognised?
faqRecognitionA: Demo mode only produces sample predictions. For real recognition, install a trained model that matches the selected sign language and landmark input shape. Lighting and camera framing can also affect tracking.
faqLanguageQ: Which sign language should I pick?
faqLanguageA: Choose the language used by the people communicating with you. ISL and ASL are distinct languages, not interchangeable gestures.
faqVoiceQ: How do I change the voice?
faqVoiceA: Use Female voice or Male voice in the caption panel. The browser fallback varies by device; configured ElevenLabs voices require voice IDs and a server environment key.
